items.title: 编写 Engineering Baseline 执行方案
items.context: 定义真实工程开发能力 baseline，包括 multi-file、existing repo、bugfix、regression、migration、security、frontend visual、long-running 等验证项。
items.userSees: 用户打开文档时看到标题 "Lattice Engineering Baseline Execution Plan"，并看到表格列出 ENG-MULTI-FILE-1 到 ENG-LOOP-REVIEW-1 的 inputs、required artifacts、pass criteria、fail criteria。

happy.desc: 文档包含 ENG-MULTI-FILE、ENG-EXISTING-REPO、ENG-BUGFIX、ENG-REGRESSION、ENG-DATA-MIGRATION、ENG-AUTH-SECURITY、ENG-FRONTEND-VISUAL、ENG-LONG-RUN、ENG-LOOP-REVIEW，并为每项写明输入、步骤、证据、pass/fail。

edge.desc: 文档必须明确 Engineering Baseline 依赖 Development Baseline 通过，且不能宣称 production-grade 或 unattended development。

adversarial.desc: 搜索文档不得出现把未验证能力写成 already production-ready 或 arbitrary project development 的 overclaim。

verificationEvidence.note: Engineering Baseline now defines maturity_target, required_engineering_runs, and a mechanical weighted correctness-protected success-rate formula so suite acceptance is executable.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Depends on: Development Baseline real PASS|does not allow|production-grade unattended" Lattice-Engineering-baseline.md
verificationEvidence.note: Engineering document still explicitly depends on Development Baseline real PASS and forbids production-grade unattended claims from this layer.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Forbidden wording|Lattice can develop any project|Lattice is production-ready" Lattice-Engineering-baseline.md
verificationEvidence.note: Engineering document still contains forbidden wording examples that block arbitrary-project and production-ready overclaims.

items.title: 编写 Loop Engineering Baseline 执行方案
items.context: 定义 UDM/Loop Engineering baseline，覆盖 intake、planner、executor、repair loop、review reflection loop、evidence gate、stop/block/escalate、多 host review 和 no false DONE。
items.userSees: 用户打开文档时看到标题 "Lattice Loop Engineering Baseline Execution Plan"，并看到 "bounded, evidence-driven, host-neutral development loop" 和 UDM-* baseline 验证表。

happy.desc: 文档包含 Loop Engineering/UDM 的核心闭环组件：intake、planner、executor、repair loop、review loop、evidence、gate、block/escalate、multi-host review、no false DONE。

edge.desc: 文档必须明确 loop 有预算、停止条件、人类交接和 blocked/escalated 结果，不能描述为无限自动循环。

adversarial.desc: 文档不得把 Loop Engineering 描述成 prompt trick 或自动脚本；必须是 bounded evidence-driven engineering system。

verificationEvidence.command: git diff --check -- Lattice-Loop-Engineering-baseline.md && rg -n "trigger_requires_human_decision|humanDecisionEvidence|DONE is blocked|run resumes only" Lattice-Loop-Engineering-baseline.md
verificationEvidence.note: UDM-HUMAN-HANDOFF-1 now seeds a human-only decision and requires blocked/escalated outcome, no DONE before human evidence, and resume only after human evidence.
Loop Engineering document still covers the UDM intake, executor, repair loop, review loop, evidence gate, and no false DONE baselines.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "prompt trick|automatic script|bounded|Forbidden wording|unlimited autonomous" Lattice-Loop-Engineering-baseline.md
verificationEvidence.note: Loop Engineering remains framed as bounded engineering rather than prompt trick or unlimited automation, with forbidden wording retained.

items.title: 编写 Production Safety Baseline 执行方案
items.context: 定义 production-grade unattended safety baseline，覆盖 false DONE trap、unsafe block、authority receipt、多 host、stale verdict、no local fallback、soak、recovery、auditability。
items.userSees: 用户打开文档时看到标题 "Lattice Production Safety Baseline Execution Plan"，并看到 "false_done_count must always be 0"、SAFE-*、AUTH-*、PROD-* 验证矩阵。

happy.desc: 文档列出 SAFE-*、AUTH-*、PROD-* baseline，并为每项写清 test setup、required artifacts、pass criteria、fail criteria。

edge.desc: 文档必须把 0 false DONE 写成 suite-level hard gate，并说明任何 false DONE 都使该层和上层 claim 失效。

adversarial.desc: 文档不得把 safety pass 简化为一次测试通过；必须包含长期 soak、stale evidence、receipt verification 和 no silent fallback。

verificationEvidence.command: git diff --check -- Lattice-Production-Safety-baseline.md && rg -n "requiredIndependentHosts >= 2 per review wave|observedIndependentHostsPerWave|valid_suite_runs|minimum_cadence|excluded_soak_runs" Lattice-Production-Safety-baseline.md
verificationEvidence.note: Production Safety now makes multi-host independence unconditional and adds production soak run count, cadence, gap, and exclusion criteria so safety cannot be proven by duration alone.
Production Safety document still lists the required SAFE, AUTH, and PROD baseline IDs after audit fixes.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "false_done_count must always be 0|If false_done_count > 0|all higher capability claims are locked" Lattice-Production-Safety-baseline.md
verificationEvidence.note: Production Safety document still makes zero false DONE a hard suite gate that locks higher capability claims if violated.

items.title: 编写 Capability Claim Baseline 执行方案
items.context: 定义能力声明 baseline，控制每层通过后允许 Lattice 宣称什么能力，明确 claim unlock、证据输入、禁止 overclaim 和机器可检查规则。
items.userSees: 用户打开文档时看到标题 "Lattice Capability Claim Baseline Execution Plan"，并看到 CLAIM-BASIC-DEV 到 CLAIM-PRODUCTION-SAFETY 的 unlock matrix 和 prohibited claims。

happy.desc: 文档包含 CLAIM-BASIC-DEV、CLAIM-ENGINEERING-DEV、CLAIM-LOOP-ENGINEERING、CLAIM-PRODUCTION-SAFETY 的 unlock 条件和 required evidence。

edge.desc: 文档必须说明高层 baseline 可以提前实现，但高层 claim 必须等待所有低层通过。

adversarial.desc: 文档必须包含 prohibited claims，禁止在缺少 suite artifacts、final reports、Authority evidence 或 0 false DONE 证明时宣传能力。

verificationEvidence.command: git diff --check -- Lattice-Capability-Claim-baseline.md && rg -n "tested task classes|stated maturity target" Lattice-Capability-Claim-baseline.md
verificationEvidence.note: Claim Baseline Suite table now keeps Loop Engineering bounded to tested task classes and Production Safety bounded to tested project classes plus stated maturity target.
Capability Claim document still contains the required claim IDs and unlock sections after table wording was tightened.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "implementation_order may be parallel|claim_unlock_order must be sequential|Higher-layer baselines may be implemented early" Lattice-Capability-Claim-baseline.md
verificationEvidence.note: Capability Claim document still states implementation can be parallel but claim unlock order must remain sequential.
